    "Predictive Analytics", "Prompt Engineering", "Quantization", "RAG", 
    "Reasoning Models", "Reinforcement Learning", "Responsible AI", 
    "Retrieval-Augmented Generation", "RLHF", "Semantic Search", "Shadow AI", 
    "Small Language Models", "Sovereign AI", "Synthetic Data", "Tensor Processing Unit", 
    "Transfer Learning", "Transformers", "Vector Database", "Vertical AI", 
    "Vision Language Models", "Voice AI", "Watsonx"
]

def extract_text(item):
    text = item.json.get('text', '') or ''
    reshared = item.json.get('resharedPost', '') or ''
    combined = f"{text} {reshared}".strip()
    return combined

def count_terms(text, term_list):
    if not text: return [], 0
    text_lower = text.lower()
    found = []
    total = 0
    for term in term_list:
        term_lower = term.lower()
        # Regex \b para evitar falsos positivos
        pattern = r'\b' + re.escape(term_lower) + r'\b'
        matches = len(re.findall(pattern, text_lower))
        if matches > 0:
            total += matches
            found.append({"term": term, "count": matches})
    return found, total

items = _input.all()
results = []

for item in items:
    full_text = extract_text(item)
    detected_terms, count = count_terms(full_text, TERMS_IA)
    
    results.append({
        "json": {
            "post_id": str(item.json.get('post_id')), # Garante string
            "full_text_for_analysis": full_text[:25000], 
            "ai_terms_count": count,
            "detected_terms": detected_terms,
            "has_ai_terms": count > 0,
            "analyzed_at": datetime.utcnow().isoformat()
        }
    })

return results
